profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Lead Engineer – Project Delivery | Scrum Master | NEC Corporation
profile.summary:
Objective:

Software engineer looking to apply my technical ability and learn new things.

Work Experience:

NECAM, Rancho Cordova –  [Aug 2020 – Current]
• Developer for our Multi-modal Biometric Identification System (MBIS).
• Responsible for developing customizable features and delivering polished solutions to law enforcement.
• Enabling complex integrations between our suite of applications.
• Revamped and fleshed out automated workflow testing suite for Criminal and civic workflows.
• Java • Spring • SOLR • Python • SQL • Liquibase

VSP, Rancho Cordova –  [October 2018 – March 2020]
• Promoted from intern to P1 Software Engineer [October 2019 - Current]
• ServiceNow Developer and Magnolia CMS Administrator 
• Responsible for implementing .NET MVC Web App for new modern VSP employee directory
• Responsible for quality assurance testing and requirements gathering projects.
• .NET MVC • C# • JavaScript • jQuery • CSS • LINQ Queries • Win SQL • HTML 

Fat’s Asian Bistro, Folsom – Server [October 2013 – August 2019]
• 7+ years in a high pressure, fast-paced, team setting, while maintaining a positive demeanor and menu knowledge.

Education:

California State University Sacramento – Graduated in Spring 2019
GPA: 3.65 – Cum Laude

Award and Certifications

• Dean’s Honor List: Spring 2017, Spring 2018
• Advance Algorithms Analysis 0-1 Knapsack Project Winner

Reference information provided upon request.
